name: opengui-plus
description: OpenGUI-Plus adds ten decoupled modules on top of OpenGUI: wireless debugging, snippet library, action templates, scheduler, project groups, demo recording, workflow marketplace, feedback RL, device pool and execution replay.

interface.longDescription: OpenGUI-Plus layers workflow tooling on top of OpenGUI without changing it: wireless (USB/WiFi/auto) device connection, a snippet library with aliases, recordable parameterised action templates, a cron scheduler, project groups that switch a whole configuration set at once, teach-by-demonstration recording, a .opengui-workflow template marketplace, a human-feedback experience loop, a multi-device pool with queueing and load balancing, and step-by-step execution replay.
defaultPrompt: Show me the OpenGUI-Plus connection status and switch to WiFi debugging.
Run my recorded action template and fill in the package name.
Create a project group for this app and switch to it.
